parameters.content:
## FlowHQ 01 - Import & validate leads
Reads your source sheet (read-only), maps columns via config/field-mapping.json, normalises and validates each row, detects duplicates and suppressed contacts, and appends NEW rows to the Leads tab.

Safe to re-run: rows already imported (same lead_id) are skipped.
